entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: An ancient treefolk sage and the last red yew treefolk on Lorwyn, who architects a plan to bring down Oona and sacrifices himself so his offspring can take his place.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The tyrannical faerie queen of Lorwyn whose downfall Colfenor's plan eventually leads to.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf elf apprenticed to Colfenor who became a hunter, then an eyeblight and outlaw, and tries to save his mentor.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The elf tribe Rhys belonged to, known for predatory treatment of Lorwyn's other races.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: A kithkin clachan where Colfenor meets Teeg and Ashling and where the Festival of Tales is held.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: A Kinsbaile figure who meets Colfenor and plays political intrigues with Nath.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin messenger who Colfenor hires to reach Rhys, and who becomes the instrument of his death.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A trio of faeries dispatched by Oona to spy on Colfenor.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A Kinsbaile archer heroine who accompanies Rhys and is redirected by Colfenor to abduct Ashling.

entities.name: Murmuring Bosk
entities.description: A sacred treefolk grove found leveled and burned, where Colfenor's seed cone is planted.

entities.name: Taercenn Nath
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf taercenn who overtook Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys and is killed by him.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A supposed Mornsong elf who joins Rhys, Brigid and Ashling; Oona's renegade twin.

entities.name: Porringer Valley
entities.description: The place where Rhys's spell went awry during an attack on a boggart gathering.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: An event in which Colfenor's sapling plays an important role.

entities.name: Colfenor's sapling
entities.description: Colfenor's offspring, who rises one day after his death carrying his and his species' wisdom.

entities.name: Ferrafor
entities.description: A remnant of Colfenor's lineage revived from a cutting of the sapling, found in the Great Forest.

events.summary: Colfenor takes Rhys as apprentice and teaches him yew magic.
events.quote: Colfenor apprenticed a young Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys

events.summary: Alerted to a great coming event, Colfenor goes to Kinsbaile to set his plan in motion.
events.quote: set in motion a chain of events that would reshape the plane's destiny

events.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
events.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

events.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
events.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

events.summary: Rhys, Ashling and Brigid find Murmuring Bosk leveled and burned, and Rhys plants the cone anyway.
events.quote: Rhys planted the cone anyway, performing a ritual to ensure its growth.

events.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
events.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

events.summary: Rhys is trapped by his former tribesmen, fights and kills Taercenn Nath, and the siege of Kinsbaile is broken.
events.quote: Rhys emerged victorious, killing the ruthless Gilt-Leaf taercenn.

events.summary: Colfenor shares the stories of his long life at the Festival of Tales.
events.quote: The gathered kithkin put aside their worries and listened with rapt attention

events.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
events.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

events.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
events.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

events.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
events.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

relations.quote: taught him the secrets of yew magic

relations.note: Architect of a plan leading to her downfall.
relations.quote: architect of a plan that would eventually lead to the downfall of the plane's tyrannical faerie queen Oona

relations.note: Sprouted from Colfenor's seed cone; his offspring.
